description: This file contains C# source code defining several Orleans grain classes related to persistent state testing, including grains with different key types and a generic grain.

classes.name: GrainStorageTestGrain
classes.description: A grain class for testing persistent state with a simple integer state.

classes.name: GrainStorageTestGrainExtendedKey
classes.description: A grain class for testing persistent state with extended key retrieval.

classes.name: GrainStorageGenericGrain<T>
classes.description: A generic grain class for testing persistent state with a generic type parameter.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of the grain's persistent state.

methods.name: DoWrite
methods.description: Writes a value to the grain's persistent state.

methods.name: DoRead
methods.description: Reads the state from the store and returns the current value.

methods.name: GetStateAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the current grain state including metadata.

methods.name: GetExtendedKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the extended key associated with the grain.
